found.name: DLTE support and training in Gen AI
found.quote: DLTE provides support and training in Gen AI for staff and students, and we should all maintain a level of critical awareness to make informed decisions about its use.

found.name: DLTE workshops and sharing practice sessions on Gen AI
found.quote: DLTE facilitates workshops, sharing practice sessions, online community spaces, and bespoke training on Gen AI in relation to learning, teaching and assessment.
found.anchor: 7. The Department of Learning and Teaching Enhancement (DLTE)

found.name: DLTE guidance and resources on Gen AI
found.quote: DLTE provides guidance and resources to academic and professional services colleagues on Gen AI in relation to learning, teaching and assessment at the University. DLTE also provides guidance and support to students on appropriate use of Gen AI.
found.anchor: 7. The Department of Learning and Teaching Enhancement (DLTE)

found.name: Academic Skills team, PDT, module leader/tutor
found.quote: If you are under pressure trying to complete an assessment and are thinking about inappropriately using an Gen AI tool to do it for you, you should avoid this and seek out other means of support, including your module leader/tutor, your PDT, the Academic Skills team, Wellbeing and Inclusion Team, and ENSA.

found.quote: ENSA provides support to students following accusations of inappropriate use of Generative AI.
